scores.evidence: The objectives are unchanged. The changed questions keep their objectiveId: q3 (o2, 「会話だけの指示が要約で落ちた。CLAUDE.mdに書く」), p1 (o1, analyze) and e4 (o2). Every objective still has an inline question and an exam question: o1 has q2, q4, p1–p3 and e1; o2 has q3, e3 and e4; o3 has q1 and e5. Apply and analyze items are present, and e1 and e4 are transfer items.

hook-problem gives a concrete scenario in three sentences (「朝に『テストは `npm test` で実行して』と伝えたのに、午後のClaudeは別のコマンドを試します」) and follows it with the ungraded predict question q0. Each distractor in q0 encodes a misconception (learning, stronger words, a bug). sum-hook answers the same scenario at the end.

Recalls carried over from earlier lessons are unchanged (s1-lead 「第1回で見たコンテキストウィンドウ」, s3-defs （第1回）, s4-defs （第4回）). New terms are defined before use. The s3-diagram rewrite moved 「プランモード（plan mode）」 into the first row of s3-table. It still appears there, in e3 and in card-survive without a recall. 「信頼の確認」 in pr-start is still not recalled either.

Measure: 「prose 1945 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 3289 · practice reading 1126 · questions 12 · practice sections 1 · est 19.8 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20)」, so estMinutes 20 matches. s2-table and s4-table now have 2 columns (「道具：起きること」, 「パターンと症状」), which fit mobile. Strict lint is clean. 5-2 is still dense: /clear, /compact, auto compaction, the focus example and --continue/--resume are all in one segment.

s5-steps is a five-step worked example placed before practice. Each step has a subgoal label and a reason, and it ends in the rewritten prompt s5-prompt. There is no faded step, and ex-learn's 「ずれた行の例」 is still not a concrete condition in s5-prompt.

The changed questions keep apply/analyze demand and give feedback on every wrong option. In q3, only option b's feedback changed (「指示が直下のCLAUDE.mdにあれば、圧縮のあとも戻ってきます。」). The p1 hint now matches the renamed column (「5-4の表の「パターンと症状」と見比べてみましょう。」), so it points to the right place without naming the answer. In e4, only option b's feedback changed. Inline checks still appear in every concept section.

The misconception coverage is unchanged and still complete: more context is better (q2-b, p1-d), reopening empties the session (q2-d, p2-c, p3-d), compaction removes all or nothing (q3-a, q3-c, e3-b, e3-d), stronger words fix it (q0-c, q4-a, e5-a). The edited feedback is more precise and still two sentences long: q3-b 「圧縮は会話を要約するだけで、設定は変えません。指示が直下のCLAUDE.mdにあれば…」 and e4-b 「…直下のCLAUDE.mdに書けば、圧縮のあとに自動で読み直されます。」.

s3-diagram now has 6 short, wrapped nodes (C[決まった
ファイルの
指示], E[読み直された
指示]) for mobile fit. Its labels match s3-lead (「決まったファイルの指示はディスクから読み直されます」) and the caption 「会話は要約に置き換わり、決まったファイルの指示はディスクから戻る」. The list that left the diagram now leads s3-table, whose caption 「図の「決まったファイル」と、そのほかのファイル」 ties the two together. There are no decorative images.

pr-code is now one command per line (mkdir / cd / git init / echo '- HTMLの<title>は「練習：」で始める' > CLAUDE.md / claude), which matches pr-start 「上のコマンドを1行ずつ実行します」. pr-prompt-a/b keep their expect text, including the self-report warning 「Claudeの分け方は自己申告なので、この2点で確かめましょう」. The pr-checklist success criteria remain observable and are now in ます form (「/context を3回実行し、使用量の変化を比べました」). pr-answer gives the model answer. The hint ladder is still one level deep. The pr-predict hint 「5-3の図で、それぞれの指示がたどる矢印を見ます」 now points to a diagram that no longer names CLAUDE.md, so the learner has to bridge through s3-table.

The summary comes after the exam. sum-points[2] is narrowed to 「圧縮のあと、直下のCLAUDE.mdや自動メモリはディスクから戻りますが…」 and is still a takeaway, not a copy of the text. sum-hook, sum-next (a reflection plus the next step to 第6回), 8 flashcards and sum-ask are unchanged.

The three wordings flagged earlier as a factual doubt are now narrowed to the audited cc-context-window table (「Project-root CLAUDE.md and unscoped rules | Re-injected from disk」): q3-b 「指示が直下のCLAUDE.mdにあれば」, e4-b 「直下のCLAUDE.mdに書けば」 and sum-points 「直下のCLAUDE.mdや自動メモリ」. s3-table row 1 lists exactly the four re-injected items, and row 2 says path-scoped rules come back on demand. The pinned version is unchanged. The generic 「ファイルに書いて残します」 remains in e4-d, and sum-points[2] ends 「いつも守らせたいことはファイルに書きます」, which path-scoped rules contradict. That keeps this criterion at 3.

です・ます is used throughout, and the checklist labels are now in polite form (「…比べました」「…説明できます」). There are no banned phrases. Terms still drift: s2-defs defines 「自動のコンテキスト圧縮」 and s2-table now bolds it, but the changed e4-b feedback still says 「自動の圧縮は、コンテキストが上限に近づくと起きるので」, and so do p2-d and the p2 explanation.

The lesson is jp-only and complete. The diagram labels are Japanese, and the diagram has a caption and alt text. The only link has descriptive text. The checklist labels and captions are plain text without markdown. The s3-diagram alt still lists 「直下のCLAUDE.md、paths:のないルール、自動メモリ、プランモード（plan mode）の計画」, which the visible diagram no longer shows. This is harmless because s3-table carries the same list, but the alt is no longer an exact equivalent.

niceToHave: pr-steps-compact pr-predict hint: s3-diagram no longer names CLAUDE.md. Replace with 「5-3の図と表で、直下のCLAUDE.mdと会話だけの指示がたどる道を見比べます。」.
s3-diagram alt: drop the sentence the diagram no longer shows, so the alt reads 「圧縮の前のコンテキストが、会話とツールの出力、決まったファイルの指示の2つに分かれる図。会話は要約に置き換わり、決まったファイルの指示はディスクから読み直されて、どちらも圧縮のあとのコンテキストに入る。中身の一覧は次の表にあります。」.

s2-table / s4-table: column 0 renders as a row header <th> at font-weight 600 (components/lesson/reader.css .rp-table tbody th), so the **bold** pattern names barely stand out from the symptom text after 「：」. Also, only row 3 of s2-table is bolded. Either drop the ** in s2-table row 3 for consistency or leave it to visual-qa to confirm on the screenshot.

Term consistency with s2-defs (still open; e4 was edited this round): write 「自動のコンテキスト圧縮」 instead of 「自動の圧縮」 in check-quiz e4 option b feedback, pr-diagnose p2 option d feedback and the p2 explanation.

factual doubt (residual generic wording): check-quiz e4 option d feedback 「決まりはファイルに書いて残します。」 → 「決まりは直下のCLAUDE.mdに書いて残します。」; sum-points[2] last sentence 「いつも守らせたいことはファイルに書きます。」 → 「いつも守らせたいことは直下のCLAUDE.mdに書きます。」.

s5-prompt (still open): ex-learn promises three conditions, but the prompt fills in only two. Replace the third line with 「前に試したときは、{{ずれた行の例}} の日付が1日ずれました。」 and add var {"name": "ずれた行の例", "hint": "例：2026-10-20,1200 の行"}.
プランモード still has no recall (now in s3-table row 1, e3 and card-survive). In s3-table row 1, write 「プランモード（plan mode、第3回）の計画」.
e4 applies o2 in a new team setting. Set its bloom to "apply" so that o2 also has an apply-level item (still open).
5-2 holds two ideas (choosing /clear or /compact, and reopening a session). Consider moving s2-session and s2-code into 5-1 after s1-defs (still open).
pr-steps-start pr-start expect (still open): 「初めてのフォルダなので、フォルダを信頼するかの確認（第1回）が出ます。承認すると、Claude Codeの入力欄が表示されます。」.
summary: Verification round: the scope check exited 0, with 13 of 47 blocks changed (16%) and no section or objective changes. The previous review had no open must-fix items, so resolved is empty. All 13 changed blocks were reviewed in full. The tables now have 2 columns, s3-diagram has short wrapped nodes, and the fixed-file list moved into s3-table row 1 under a caption that ties it to the diagram. The factual-doubt wordings (q3-b, e4-b, sum-points[2]) are narrowed to 直下のCLAUDE.md, the p1 hint follows the renamed column, pr-code is one command per line, and the checklist is in ます form. None of these introduces an error or a regression that needs a must-fix. Small follow-ons are in niceToHave: the pr-predict hint still points only to the diagram, and the diagram alt lists items the diagram no longer shows. validate and lint --strict are clean, and the measure reports prose 1945 and est 19.8 min against estMinutes 20. Every criterion is at 3 or above (mean 3.46).
